description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2062/22 of 14.03.2018, Meerigama D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 510285
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with the amendment of land title registration details for a specific parcel of land, including servitude rights and utility access rights. It falls under the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership details, and amendments to land title particulars under the Registration of Title Act. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement making changes to land title records.
